seasonal_assignment.purpose: Retrospective audit of the two freely assigned base forms. No new test of the original frozen author packet.

distribution.note: The f85r2 source fit supplies no manuscript-wide expectation for frequency, section, Currier or selector dispersion.

repetition_and_position.note: The seasonal source fit does not account for daiin repetition and its physical-position distribution elsewhere.

constructions.note: The fixed source fit does not interpret the retained f22r X+daiin constructions or other admitted complete contexts.

form_relations.note: The author selects qo|dar and qo|daiin only; other lookalikes remain whole values or unknown, not predicted seasonal morphology.

grammar.note: IDEA595 authors local types, boundaries and productions. Those do not define a manuscript-wide transferable seasonal syntax.

meaning_discriminator.note: No independent consequence selects these season meanings over alternatives; atomic seasonal-heat values fit the local composed cases too.

No significance, calibrated probability or confirmed translation.
